ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: PolyGo uses your photos only so you can choose your profile picture.
ios.NSUserTrackingUsageDescription: PolyGo uses this to measure which ads brought you to the app and to show you more relevant ads. We never sell your data.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: PolyGo uses the microphone only for speaking exercises: it listens to your answer and compares it with the sentence. Your voice is not stored.
ios.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: PolyGo transcribes your voice in speaking exercises to check how you say the sentence.
